name: Lyo.Authentication.OpenIdConnect
tagline: OpenID Connect client base for Lyo. The Lyo API is the OIDC confidential client (BFF pattern). The frontend never sees the IdP and never receives tokens by URL fragment.
description:
OpenID Connect client base for Lyo. The Lyo API is the OIDC confidential client (BFF pattern). The frontend never sees the IdP and never receives tokens by URL fragment. After a successful external login, the API either:

- issues tokens directly as JSON, for API clients calling `/auth/login/{provider}?mode=api`, or
- mints a single-use handoff code and 302-redirects the browser to a whitelisted consumer origin, which then exchanges that code server-to-server for the tokens, for browser clients via `Lyo.Authentication.Client`.

sections.title: Building blocks
items: `IOpenIdConnectProvider.` Abstraction describing a provider: discovery URL, client id/secret, scope/claim mapping.
`OidcJwksResolver.` Fetches and caches the provider's JWKS for `id_token` signature verification.
`PkceCodes` + `StateNonceProtector.` Generate and seal PKCE/state/nonce in an HTTP-only cookie via `IDataProtector`.
`OidcTokenExchangeClient.` Typed `HttpClient` that POSTs the authorization code back for tokens.
`OidcIdTokenValidator.` Validates issuer, audience, nonce, exp, signature.
`OidcSsoProtocol.` OpenID Connect `ISsoProtocol`. `CompleteAsync` validates the code and id_token, then calls SSO completion once.
`IExternalLoginCoordinator` / `DefaultExternalLoginCoordinator.` Facade over `OidcSsoProtocol`. It returns the token that completion already minted. It does not mint a second JWT.

sections.title: Endpoints
rows: OpenID Connect redirect. Browser mode mints a handoff code and 302s to `{returnUrl}?lyo_handoff=lyoh_...`. API mode returns 200 OK with `{access_token, refresh_token, expires_in, token_type}`.
SAML HTTP-POST. Form fields `SAMLResponse` and `RelayState`. Antiforgery is disabled; the login ticket is the cross-site control. Browser handoff only.
Body `{ code }`. Consumes a handoff code once, returns tokens. Audited as `HandoffCodeConsumed` / `HandoffCodeRejected`.
Reserved for first-party API client grants.
Body `{ refresh_token }`. Returns a rotated `{access_token, refresh_token, expires_in}`.
Body `{ refresh_token }`. Revokes the token; audited as `TokenRevoked` + `SignedOut`.
Returns the principal for the bearer access token.

Returns the same shape as `/auth/me` for an arbitrary user id. Requires the `auth.users.read` scope (policy `scope:auth.users.read`). `Scopes` reflects the target user's baseline scopes, not the caller's.
sections.lead: `Lyo.Authentication.Sso` maps these with `app.MapLyoAuthEndpoints()`. The OpenID Connect package keeps an obsolete forwarder of that method.

sections.title: Registration
sections.text: `AddLyoOpenIdConnect(IConfiguration)` does not bind BFF options. `AddLyoSso(IConfiguration)` binds `LyoExternalLogin` and `LyoSso`. The per-provider packages register their `IOpenIdConnectProvider` under their canonical name (`google`, `keycloak:<realm>`), and that name is also registered on `SsoProtocolRegistry`.

sections.title: BFF options
Auditing
rows: New `(provider, subject)` linked to a user.
Mint succeeded; included in the browser redirect.
Wrong origin, expired, unknown, or already consumed.
sections.lead: Every meaningful state transition emits an `AuthAuditEvent`. With `Lyo.Authentication.Postgres` wired up these land in `[user].[event]`. The `kind` column stores the enum's string name, `JwtIssued`, `HandoffCodeIssued`, and so on. Otherwise they hit whatever `IAuthAuditRecorder` is registered, default `NullAuthAuditRecorder`. IP, User-Agent, and correlation come from the registered `IAuthAuditContextAccessor`. Call `services.AddLyoApiTokenAuthentication()` or `services.AddLyoAuthHttpContextAccessor()` standalone on an ASP.NET host to swap in `HttpAuthAuditContextAccessor`.

sections.title: Talking to it
items: **Browser consumers.** Use `Lyo.Authentication.Client` for handoff redemption, the session cookie, and `LyoAuthDelegatingHandler` for outbound refresh.
**API clients.** Call `/auth/login/{provider}?mode=api` and consume the JSON token response directly. Call `/auth/refresh` when the access token nears expiry.
